description.value: Bridgeview Community Centre is a City of Surrey municipal recreation facility located in the Whalley neighbourhood, offering drop-in programs, gymnasium access, and various community activities. It serves a residential area of Surrey and provides seniors, youth, and general recreation programming. Touring cyclists passing through Surrey could potentially use it as a rest stop, though it is not a destination attraction.
